questions.html: A program on workstation $\text{A}$ attempts to open a TCP connection to port $\textsf{1FFD H}$ on a machine $\text{B},$ and a UDP connection to port $\textsf{5EFA H}$ on machine $\text{C}.$ Which of the two machines generate an ICMP port unreachable error if both the applications on the corresponding ports on $\mathrm{B}$ and $\mathrm{C}$ are down?
questions.solution:
Answer: C

questions.html:
Which of the following statements are true about TCP?

  1. It is a byte-oriented port-to-port communication
  2. It uses flow control mechanism protocol
  3. Its connections are link to link and full duplex
  4. It uses piggybacking whenever possible

questions.html: Host $\text{A}$ has to $\text{‘inject'}\; 30 \;\text{Mbits}$ of data into a network via a token bucket regulator. The token bucket has a capacity of $15 \mathrm{~Mbits}$ and is filled with tokens at the rate of $5 \mathrm{~Mbps}$. Data is buffered if it arrives at the regulator when there are no tokens in the bucket. How long does it take, in total, for the $30 \;\text{Mbits}$ of data to enter the network, assuming that the host sends at a peak rate of $20 \mathrm{~Mbps}$ and the token bucket is initially full?
questions.solution:
Answer: A

questions.html: Depicted below is a sequence of packet exchange in a TCP connection between Host $\text{A}$ and $\text{B}.$ Host $\text{A}$ sends the last data packet and receives the ACK packet from Host $\text{B}.$ Then, Host $\text{A}$ sends a $\text{FIN}$ packet to initiate closing of the connection. Host $\text{B}$ sends a $\text{FIN}$ packet as well. Tell the value of $a, b, c, d, e.$
questions.solution:

questions.html:
A TCP connection starts with cwnd $=1 \mathrm{MSS}$ and transmits packets of constant size $1\mathrm{MSS}.$ Let's also assume the delayed ack is disabled for simplicity. With the initial cwnd $=1 \mathrm{MSS}$, the sender sends the $1^{\text {st }}$ data packet (sequence number $0 )$ to the receiver. After receiving the $1^{\text {st }}$ ACK packet (ack sequence number $1\text{MSS)}$ from the receiver, the sender increases the cwnd to $2 \mathrm{MSS}$. The sender can therefore send the $2^{\text {nd }}$ and $3^{\text {rd }}$ data packet back-to-back. The $2^{\text {nd }}$ and $3^{\text {rd }}$ ACK packet will come back and trigger changes to cwnd subsequently. This will go on and all data and ACK packets will come through smoothly except for the $9^{\text {th }}$ data packet. It is dropped. Listed below are the values of cwnd receiving $12$ ACK packets respectively.
$$(2\mathrm{MSS}, 3\mathrm{MSS}, 4\mathrm{MSS}, 4.25\mathrm{MSS}, a, b, c, d, d, d, d, d, \ldots)$$
What is the value of $a,b,c$ and $d?$
Fractional values in $\mathrm{MSS}$ can be converted to integer in bytes.
questions.solution:
Answer: A, B, C, D

Official discussion page

questions.html:
Consider traces of TCP congestion window size recorded over time from $5$ different connections.

  • Connection $\text{A}: 1, 2, 4, 8, 16, 17, 18, 19$
  • Connection $\text{B}: 1, 2, 4, 8, 9, 10, 11, 12$
  • Connection $\text{C}: 1,2,4,5,6,3,4,5$
  • Connection $\text{D}: 1,2,3,4,1,2,3,4$
  • Connection $\text{E}: 1, 2, 4, 8, 16, 32, 1, 2$

Which of the following is/are true about the above connections?

options.html: Except Connection $\text{E},$ all connections ended in the congestion avoidance state at the end of the recording
ONLY Connection $\text{C}$ experienced a packet loss detected by receiving $3$ duplicate acknowledgment packets
ONLY $\text{D}$ experienced a packet loss detected by not receiving any new acknowledgment packet after a retransmission timeout event
ONLY $\text{E}$ experienced a packet loss detected by not receiving any new acknowledgment packet after a retransmission timeout event

questions.solution:
Answer: A, B

questions.html:
Alice is a musician and she wants to send her new song to Bob as a $\text{2-MB MP3}$ file. The bottleneck link between their computers has a $10\text{-Mbps}$ transmission rate. Assume the header overhead for link layer of both networks to be $26\;\text{bytes }$and all other headers used does not have options.

It is not known if TCP or UDP is used by sender. Which of the following is/are CORRECT ?

options.html: If UDP is used then $4386$ datagrams are generated from Alice’s computer.
If TCP is used then $4482$ datagrams are generated from Alice.
If UDP is used then $13514$ datagrams are recived at Bob’s computer.
If TCP is used then $13444$ datagrams are recived at Bob’s computer.

questions.solution:
Answer: B, D

questions.html:
Assume that the TCP sequence number field is defined using $16$ bits, so the sequence number space is $\{0,1,2,\dots,2^{16}-1\} $, and the sequence number wraps around to $0$ after reaching $2^{16}-1$.

A TCP connection has already been established, and the sender assigns the initial sequence number as $\mathrm{ISN}=33535$.

Assume that each increment of the TCP sequence number corresponds to exactly $1$ byte of transmitted data, and the data transmission rate is $32\,\text{MBps}$, where $1\,\text{MB}=10^{6}$ bytes.

How long (in milliseconds) will it take for the TCP sequence number to wrap around and become $0$ for the first time?

A TCP connection is established between two processes $\text{P1}$ and $\text{P2}$ running on different hosts. Segment size is set to $800\;\text{bytes}$ for this connection. Initially, the ssthresh at $\text{P1}$ is $7000\;\text{bytes}.$ Then, $\text{P1}$ receives a TCP ACK reporting a rwnd size of $4000\;\text{bytes}.$ After reception and processing of this ACK, the cwnd value is $7200\;\text{bytes}.$ How many maximum-sized segments can $\text{P1}$ transmit now (i.e., after the ACK processing)?

The following is a dump of UDP header in hexadecimal format $:\textsf{5EFA00FD001C3297}.$

What is the total length of user datagram?
questions.solution:
Answer: B
